import type { FABContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class FAB extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        icon: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        showLabel: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        disabled: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        expanded: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultExpanded: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        actions: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    icon: string;
    showLabel: boolean;
    disabled: boolean;
    expanded: boolean | undefined;
    defaultExpanded: boolean | undefined;
    actions: FABContract['actions'];
    private state;
    private returnAfterClose;
    constructor();
    get committedExpanded(): boolean;
    private show;
    private escape;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
